sentences.en: Because of his achievements, he is held in high esteem.
sentences.zh: 因为他的成就，他备受尊重。

sentences.en: This is the love that esteems others better than oneself.
sentences.zh: 这是一种比爱自己更爱他人的爱。

sentences.en: I esteem it an honor to address this audience.
sentences.zh: 能为这个观众群体演讲是我的荣幸。

phrases.zh: 很高的评价；很高的尊敬
